relayConfigs.name: LCRNS reference constellation, 5 satellites
relayConfigs.description: Simulated from NASA's LCRNS reference constellation v3.1: a government reference design, not deployed and not the final design (Intuitive Machines chooses that). Five ~30 h elliptical frozen orbits with apolune over the south pole, propagated two-body.

basedOn.source: NASA Lunar Communications Relay and Navigation Systems (LCRNS) reference constellation v3.1, Tables 1-2
basedOn.notes: Config lcrns-ref-5sat is D-19: proposed, not yet agreed.

relayConfigs.name: LCRNS reference, SV-1 only
relayConfigs.description: Only satellite SV-1 of NASA's LCRNS reference constellation v3.1, to show what a single relay gives against the full five. A reference design, not deployed and not a planned one-satellite system. One ~30 h elliptical frozen orbit with apolune over the south pole, propagated two-body.

basedOn.source: NASA Lunar Communications Relay and Navigation Systems (LCRNS) reference constellation v3.1, Tables 1-2 (SV-1 row only)
basedOn.notes: Config lcrns-ref-1sat is D-19 (P1 relay configs): proposed, not yet agreed.

relayConfigs.name: ESA Lunar Pathfinder (assumed phasing)
relayConfigs.description: Simulated from the indicative baseline orbit in SSTL's Lunar Pathfinder service guide: one ~10.8 h elliptical lunar frozen orbit (a 5740 km, e 0.58, i 54.9°), planned for 2027 and not in orbit in this window. The guide gives no epoch, frame, RAAN or phase, so we ASSUME them (epoch 2027-03-01 00:00 UTC, RAAN 0°, true anomaly 0°): when the passes happen is illustrative. Propagated two-body.

basedOn.source: SSTL Lunar Pathfinder Services Service Guide v2.3, sec. 3.4.3 (indicative baseline orbit)
basedOn.notes: Config lunar-pathfinder is D-19 (P1 relay configs): proposed, not yet agreed. Epoch, frame, RAAN and phase assumed.
